policy: Scientific breakthrough and resource-bounded reproducible OOD transfer outrank gate count, throughput, synthetic FIT advancement or infrastructure building.

Wingless.candidate: W-F57 recurrent 7-state public-belief transition + learned calibration
Wingless.observed: 49/64 learned vs 44/64 budgeted beam (+5 cases), 42/64 frozen MAP; FIT-only, incomplete strong controls, no fully proven native memory budget
Wingless.acceptance: two independently originated non-renaming-equivalent unseen relation composition/topology sources, frozen before fit; outperform strongest equal-compute memory control in each at total CPU+peak-memory <= baseline, physically verify <=576B; strong fully-public symbolic comparator included

Yggdrasil.candidate: Y-F105 12-feature trained native delayed-credit scorer; best measured learned action variant in inspected recent lineage, NOT proven superior
Yggdrasil.observed: 12-feature learned 9/32 vs F60 fixed 8/32; 20-feature relational learner 3/32; old F102 learned 0/32; negative under preregistered improvement screen
Yggdrasil.acceptance: new streaming causal-event topology grammar not a role/order permutation of F62; same native <=144B total persistent payload with weights/transients counted; equal-or-lower actual CPU and peak memory vs F60; causal ablation and independent terminal-answer replay on 2 independent OOD source families

Mass_Research.candidate: F124-AZ public-only jointly fitted affine/Feistel inverse as coverage reference, NOT accepted transferable cognition
Mass_Research.observed: 23/24 held SCREEN, FP0, 11/12 Feistel; FIT had FP1 and failed frozen advancement; joint balanced held ~9.274s CPU vs affine ~3.045s, equal public 48 != equal compute; no transfer gain established
Mass_Research.new_hypothesis: Replace dual exhaustive generator-aligned inverse fitting and repeated structural-veto tweaks with one shared learned operator-agnostic representation that retains relational composition and transfers to held new primitive/graph grammar from independently originated source; no Feistel catalog labels or source-family routing
Mass_Research.acceptance: nonzero newly learned family transfer replicated on 2 independent genuinely novel task-structure sources; strict paired superiority over strongest full-public equal-information cost-matched control; measured full CPU and peak memory <= strongest control; no leakage; all protected negative/positive case IDs retained

Optimizer_Work.candidate: Dream-RSI plus Pareto scientific research allocation against frozen alternatives; NOT scientific learner trained on F124 FIT negatives
Optimizer_Work.evidence_interface: researchfeedback/f124_negative_intake.py -> read-only authenticated development advisory; original F85 negative quarantine remains intact
Optimizer_Work.new_hypothesis: Compare prospectively frozen portfolio ranking based on authenticated training-only mechanism diagnostics against frozen round-robin/random and current selection at equal cost, using accepted unseen-transfer outcomes only AFTER independent science admission
Optimizer_Work.acceptance: at least two new independently accepted cross-source transfer improvements under equal total experiment+selector compute/memory, independently reproduced; no retrospective outcome labels, blind source ownership, no synthetic-only success counted

shared_protocol.selection: Freeze source tree exact SHA, training/holdout membership, candidate and fair controls, task families, parameter/byte budgets and thresholds precode
shared_protocol.independence: New heldout STRUCTURE family not reachable by relabeling/permuting/seed changes in TRAIN grammar; independent source/oracle code plus pre-outcome provenance verified by independent auditor; external data provenance required before OOD claims
shared_protocol.data_release: Train only on training; do not evaluate unseen until exact immutable FIT source passes; second independent reapplication required; diagnostics and negative cases retained
shared_protocol.cost: Same public information, paired actual wall/CPU and peak RSS or lower-level peak memory; count weights, persistent and temporary state, search, query costs, cache and source prep separately; don't call equal query budgets equal compute
shared_protocol.success: Per independent family >=8 additional correct cases per 128 over strongest resource-eligible control, paired one-sided McNemar p<0.05 (adjust across families), no family regressions, no false-positive increase; measured CPU median and p95 AND peak memory <= frozen matched control
shared_protocol.fail_closed: If no genuinely independent structural population or no complete cost audit, development may continue but do not report OOD success or optimizer win
